Remark
[Lie and covariant derivatives agree where $T$ vanishes]

Source: petersen:page-0090 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative

1. ch2:2.5.18If a tensor field $T$ vanishes at $p$, then \[ (L_XT)_p=( abla _XT)_p. \] \sketch Indeed, subsection 3.2 gives $L_XT= abla _XT-( abla X)T$, and the algebraic final term vanishes with $T_p$. Applied at a critical point to the $(1,1)$ Hessian, this identifies its metric-independent first variation.
